set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q03
Accountable role (person not assigned): Institutional operator and service owner

Outcome: An operator can own a bounded institutional beta and recover it without the original engineer or server.

Acceptance:
- A different operator installs/upgrades the packaged release, diagnoses an injected fault and restores onto replacement infrastructure using the documented independent backup/policy sources.
- Revoke access and withdraw data after backup, then lose the original host; verify current restrictions, exact retained exports and coherent pending work after recovery; meet accepted RPO/RTO.
- Verify real alert/escalation delivery and support responsibilities, record beta observation criteria and runbook results, and identify any conditional source/visualization gate. Production cutover requires a separate service-owner decision.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#5-what-qualification-must-prove

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: Q03: Rehearse clean-host recovery and institutional operator handover
